title: My Baby Monitor Picks Up a Lullaby Every Night at 2:14 a.m.…
hook: Every night at 2:14 a.m., my baby monitor starts singing
story: Every night at exactly 2:14 a.m., my baby monitor picks up a woman singing a lullaby. I live alone with my son. The first night, I ran into his room so fast I hit the door frame. He was sound asleep. Nobody there. The singing was still coming through the speaker in my hand. I figured it was interference. Old monitors pick up the neighbors sometimes. So the next morning, I knocked on the door of the apartment next to mine. An older woman answered. I asked, a little embarrassed, if she sings to a baby at night. She went pale. She said she used to, a long time ago. Her daughter. Then she said the thing that made my arms go cold. "That room your son sleeps in used to be her nursery. We lived in your apartment before we moved next door." I didn't know what to say. So I went home and told myself it was a coincidence. That night, at 2:14, the singing started again. Same song. Same soft voice. But this time, halfway through, it stopped. And a woman whispered, very close to the microphone: "He's a good sleeper. You're doing fine." I haven't turned the monitor off since. And every night at exactly 2:14 a.m.… I listen.

Some lullabies never stop. 🌙
